outline: This course introduces students to the concepts and techniques of intelligent and soft computing and their applications. Topics mainly include neural computations, fuzzy computations, evolutionary computations, natural language processing, and speech recognition. The lecture format will be a combination of slide presentation, chalk talk and computer demonstration. Through algorithmic investigation and case analysis, students will learn the skills and strategies that are necessary for effectively processing big data in real applications. Furthermore, Problem-Based Learning (PBL) method will be applied in this course. In addition to the theoretical study, students are guided to survey the related references, discuss and brainstorm by group, and conduct the practice projects, so that the capability of creativity and innovation can be developed during the course.
schedule:
Week 1: Class announcement and introduction to intelligent computing
Week 2: Supervised learning and unsupervised learning
Week 3: Fuzzy computations
Week 4: Evolutionary computations
Week 5: Natural language processing
Week 6: Speech recognition
assessment:
Attendance and Participation 20%
Assignments 20%
Quiz  30%
Oral presentation 30%
